$comment: Reference body for POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/agents/create. Suitable as the input to scripts/create-agent.sh. The dashboard 'Test AI Agent' button uses the same fields. After deploying the Worker, replace the {{...}} placeholders. Anything you don't want to set is omitted; ElevenLabs defaults take over.
name: Atlas Dev

agent.$comment_agent: First message + system prompt + LLM config + language settings.

prompt.$comment_prompt: System prompt content. Paste the body of packages/prompts/system_v1.md here. The {{system__time}}, {{system__timezone}}, {{user_name}} dynamic vars are resolved by ElevenLabs at conversation start.

tts.$comment_tts: Default to Flash v2.5 for low TTFA; voice_id swapped to user's IVC during onboarding (Phase 0.F). 'Adam' as dev default (ADR 0016).

asr.$comment_asr: Scribe v2 Realtime — 150ms STT with multilingual + atypical-speech support.

conversation.$comment_conversation: Realtime voice loop client events. Custom-LLM metadata enabled so the Worker can pipe debug info back to the desktop.

turn.$comment_turn: Normal eagerness for general conversation; turn_timeout 10s; mode 'turn' (server-side VAD) preferred for desktop mic. Soft timeout 3.0s with static filler — Flash v2.5 + Claude usually returns first token < 800ms so filler will rarely fire.

auth.$comment_auth: Allow desktop client to start sessions without server-side auth in dev. In production, use signed-URL flow (apps/desktop calls Worker → Worker calls ElevenLabs convai/conversation/get-signed-url with API key → returns short-lived URL to desktop).

evaluation.$comment_evaluation: Phase 0 — no formal evaluation criteria yet. Add in Phase 1 once the eval suite exists.

widget.$comment_widget: We don't use the web widget; conversation is via direct WebSocket from the Tauri desktop in Phase 0.E.

safety.$comment_safety: Mute toggle, end-call tool both available in case Phase 11 proactive features need them.

privacy.$comment_privacy: Retain audio for now during dev/beta for debugging real failures; flip to no-retention before public launch.

call_limits.$comment_call_limits: Free-form cost guardrails enforced by Atlas-side rate limiter; ElevenLabs side keeps generous defaults.
